gate_assessment: borderline-supported: combined point estimate is near the prespecified 25% threshold, replicates across two independent task batches, but uncertainty includes materially lower values and the intervention is a peer rewrite rather than an OPD update
unit: A recipient's byte-exact single-write action, counted once. It is failure-relevant if at least one same-checkpoint peer's byte-exact write version fixes a failed factor. It is mixed if any such replacement also regresses a passed factor.
